title: A non-functional overview: load, performance, stress, security and accessibility

videos.script: Everything so far asked what boxoffice does. This lesson asks how well. {{how}} How fast does a page come back? What happens when two hundred people book at once? {{load}} What does an error page tell a stranger? {{security}} Can somebody who never touches a mouse buy a ticket? {{access}} These are the non-functional families. Each one has its own tools and its own specialists. {{families}} You will time a request with curl, and then send twenty at once. {{curl}} You will read the error page of lesson 4 again, this time as a leak. {{leak}} And you will walk the booking page with the keyboard alone, and find a field that has no label. {{label}} An automated checker passes that field. A person does not. {{tool}} This lesson is an overview. The course that goes deep is Non-functional Testing, in this same track. {{next}}
